name: Cedar
description: An older adult woman with a resonant low alto, a light Ghanaian English accent, unhurried musical phrasing, and warm, clear consonants. She sounds amused, capable, and attentive. Natural conversational English. Clean studio recording.
purpose: An elder with warmth and musical rhythm. Try her as a healer, a stern creditor, and a travelling storyteller.
text: The road is quiet this morning. Come inside, and tell me where you are going. We can find a place for your horses.
